sections.Profile:
"Oktoberfest" by American Pinball, released in October 2018, immerses players in a vibrant festival atmosphere. Designed by Joe Balcer, this machine features three flippers, three ramps, and six multiball modes. Key gameplay elements include the Corkscrew Rollercoaster, a Shack & Beer Barrel with 3-ball lock mechanisms, and Otto the Bartender, an interactive target and ball lock assembly. Players can explore over a dozen tents, collect beer steins, and enjoy a variety of mini-games and modes.
